_comment: Named-verifier roster (ROADMAP §4, ADR-3). Every corpus record's source.verifier MUST appear here by exact name, so an unknown/typo'd verifier cannot be committed. A verifier marked placeholder:true is an illustrative seed reviewer, NOT a real human verification — any record verified by a placeholder is mechanically valid but is NEVER launch-cleared. Replacing the placeholder with a real, accountable human verifier (per jurisdiction) is the OPEN P0 review-gate in docs/STATUS.md.

roster.name: Pilot Seed Reviewer
roster.note: Illustrative seed data only (ADR-3). Records carrying this verifier are not launch-cleared; they exist to exercise the gates against realistic-shaped content.
